# Historical performance baseline

`performance-baseline.json` is the unchanged baseline report consumed by
`scripts/measure-redesign.mjs`. It measured the original app at
`3117d47b9cdd3a844d063fbde2ca6cd5ff3a83d2`; browser version, methodology, and raw
samples are embedded in the report. Do not regenerate it from the current app
or replace it merely to make a performance comparison pass.

The file moved from `docs/evidence/baseline/baseline-report.json` during cleanup.
Its screenshot filenames describe historical captures, not required local files.
The original runner, screenshots, and report remain in the
[immutable evidence archive](https://github.com/RobertCarrUTA/recipe-book/tree/fa5377b6c952e179d24ab740cde4377273c1d954/docs/evidence/baseline).
See [performance budgets](../../docs/performance-budgets.md) for current usage.
